dedupe_keys.name: bison fute its directive road data french national access point for road traffic data

description: Bison Futé, the French road traffic information service, is the national access point for the road data covered by the Intelligent Transport Systems Directive. Its ITS page says the data available so far fall into main categories including real-time traffic data (congestion, hourly flow, travel times) and road safety-related traffic information (slippery road, wrong-way driver, obstacle on the carriageway, accident), and it explains the directive's motivation: growing road transport volumes and mobility demand causing congestion and energy use, which ITS applications aim to address. Coverage: French roads covered by the service. Format and access: data services described on the page. Licence and cost: free to consult; reuse terms not stated on the page. Caveats: the page describes categories, not listing datasets. It supports network flow and emergency response studies on French roads. It relates to the French transport data access point, the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
